g.text: Eight previously selected directions; alpha ±4. n = new-corpus target-token count.
Left: paired 95% block-bootstrap intervals, 16 adjacent windows per block. Right: descriptive maximum cost; no interval on the maximum.
Token sets include fragments and whitespace. Permuted controls have unequal NLL costs; see the report.
